records.name: TickTick
records.summary: Task planning with lists, reminders, calendars, and habit tracking.
records.platforms: Web, Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS/iPadOS, Android
records.pricing: Free tier with optional annual Premium subscription.
records.tradeoff: Free tier limits list and task capacity; expanded calendar views require Premium.

records.name: Remember The Milk
records.summary: Task lists with reminders, sharing, and cross-device synchronization.
records.platforms: Web, Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS/iPadOS, Android
records.pricing: Free Basic tier with optional annual Pro subscription.
records.tradeoff: Subtasks and offline use in the web app are listed as Pro features.

records.name: Toodledo
records.summary: Configurable tasks, notes, outlines, lists, and habit tracking.
records.platforms: Web, iOS, Android
records.pricing: Free tier plus recurring Standard and Plus subscriptions.
records.tradeoff: Free tier has one week of task history; subtasks are listed under Standard.

records.name: Things
records.summary: Personal tasks and project planning for Apple devices.
records.platforms: macOS, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro
records.pricing: Paid App Store applications; regional prices must be checked in the App Store.
records.tradeoff: The listed applications cover Apple devices; Windows and Android support is not established by this source.

records.name: OmniFocus
records.summary: Personal task management with perspectives and project reviews.
records.platforms: macOS, iOS/iPadOS, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro; Web edition
records.pricing: Paid purchase or subscription, following a 14-day trial; Web access should be checked against the selected plan.
records.tradeoff: The Web edition requires an active connection; native applications listed here are for Apple devices.

records.name: Vikunja
records.summary: Self-hostable task management with list, Kanban, Gantt, and table views.
records.platforms: Web application, with self-hosted or managed Cloud deployment
records.pricing: Free self-hosted software with optional paid managed Cloud hosting; infrastructure costs are separate.
records.tradeoff: Self-hosting requires operating your own server; managed hosting is paid.

records.name: LanguageTool
records.summary: Multilingual spelling, grammar, and style checking with optional paraphrasing tools.
records.platforms: Web, Windows, macOS, iOS; browser and office add-ons
records.pricing: Free checking tier with optional Premium and team plans.
records.tradeoff: The free version covers basic corrections; the vendor reserves the complete error set for Premium.

records.name: ProWritingAid
records.summary: Grammar and style reports plus tools for planning and editing stories.
records.platforms: Web; Windows and macOS integrations; browser and office integrations
records.pricing: Free tier with paid Premium plans and separate Story Credits for advanced analysis.
records.tradeoff: Free line-editing reports have daily run limits; some advanced story analysis uses credits.

records.name: Hemingway Editor Classic
records.summary: Desktop readability editing that highlights sentence complexity and style issues.
records.platforms: Windows, macOS
records.pricing: Paid desktop license sold through the vendor's linked checkout.
records.tradeoff: Classic excludes the new AI features; its described workflow focuses on readability and style highlights.

records.name: Antidote
records.summary: Writing assistance combining a corrector, dictionaries, and language guides.
records.platforms: Windows desktop (Antidote 12); Web application (Antidote Web)
records.pricing: Antidote+ annual subscription covers the product line; other editions and organizational licensing require separate review.
records.tradeoff: Generative reformulation in Antidote 12 requires an eligible subscription; language-module choice affects the offer.

records.name: Ginger
records.summary: English grammar correction and rephrasing across desktop, browser, and mobile workflows.
records.platforms: Windows, macOS, iOS, Android; Chrome/Edge extensions and Word add-in
records.pricing: Free entry points with paid Premium subscriptions on monthly or longer billing terms.
records.tradeoff: Premium advertises unlimited correction and rephrasing; promotional amounts should not be treated as permanent prices.

records.name: Quillbot
records.summary: Grammar checking, paraphrasing, and other writing tools.
records.platforms: Web, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android; browser extensions and Word add-in
records.pricing: Free tier with paid Premium and team subscriptions.
records.tradeoff: Free paraphrasing has a word limit; advanced grammar recommendations require Premium. Platform limits may differ.

records.name: PDFgear
records.summary: PDF editing, annotation, conversion, and OCR tools across desktop and mobile.
records.platforms: Windows, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, Android; Web tools
records.pricing: The vendor describes its PDF editor and listed core tools as free.
records.tradeoff: Desktop applications, browser tools, and the separately linked eSignGear service have different workflow scopes; check the required operation.

records.name: PDF24 Creator
records.summary: Windows PDF tools and a virtual PDF printer that process files locally.
records.platforms: Windows
records.pricing: Free for private and commercial use.
records.tradeoff: Creator supports Windows only; PDF24 browser tools are a separate online workflow.

records.name: PDF-XChange Editor
records.summary: Windows PDF editing with annotation and optional advanced features.
records.platforms: Windows 10 and later
records.pricing: Free and licensed features; paid Editor and Editor Plus licenses are listed separately.
records.tradeoff: Enhanced OCR and form creation are Editor Plus features; AI processing requires supplying an AI account API key.

records.name: Foxit PDF Editor
records.summary: PDF editing, conversion, OCR, forms, and document security.
records.platforms: Windows, macOS, Web; Editor+ adds iOS and Android
records.pricing: Subscriptions and a separate perpetual desktop license are offered.
records.tradeoff: The perpetual edition excludes AI Assistant and cloud features; mobile access belongs to Editor+.

records.name: Sejda
records.summary: Browser and desktop tools for editing, converting, and organizing PDFs.
records.platforms: Web, Windows, macOS, Linux
records.pricing: Limited free use; paid week passes, monthly Web access, and annual Desktop+Web access.
records.tradeoff: Free use has limits. Web uploads files to the service; Desktop processes locally. New perpetual licenses are not offered.

records.name: Stirling PDF
records.summary: Local and self-hostable PDF editing tools, with additional automation offerings.
records.platforms: Web, desktop, self-hosted deployment; specific desktop operating systems require review
records.pricing: Free individual editor; paid Team and Enterprise tiers, with separately metered processor credits.
records.tradeoff: Team administration and enterprise deployment features belong to paid tiers; processing automation has credit-based pricing.

records.name: Insight Timer
records.summary: Guided meditation and sleep audio with a meditation timer.
records.platforms: iOS, Android; browser audio and timer
records.pricing: Free audio library with optional annual Member Plus subscription.
records.tradeoff: Offline listening and additional premium courses are listed as Member Plus features.

records.name: Medito
records.summary: Free guided meditations, breathing exercises, sleep content, and a timer.
records.platforms: iOS, Android
records.pricing: Free nonprofit app with no premium tier or paywall.
records.tradeoff: The documented offering is mobile meditation and sleep audio; equivalence to every Calm content category is unverified.

records.name: Smiling Mind
records.summary: Meditations and mental-fitness learning pathways for adults and children.
records.platforms: iOS, Android
records.pricing: Free app for individuals and families, supported by a nonprofit.
records.tradeoff: Access requires creating an account; the app's mental-fitness pathways should not be described as a complete Calm replacement.

records.name: Healthy Minds Program
records.summary: Meditation practices and lessons organized into a wellbeing learning path.
records.platforms: iOS, Android
records.pricing: Free donor-supported app; separate courses and events may be paid.
records.tradeoff: The setup instructions require registration; the free app and paid courses or events are separate offers.

records.name: Balance
records.summary: Personalized guided meditation assembled around user answers and goals.
records.platforms: iOS, Android
records.pricing: Trial and paid subscription offers; current amount and trial duration need review in the selected offer.
records.tradeoff: Personalization uses answers about experience and goals; a free trial does not establish permanently free core use.

records.name: Waking Up
records.summary: Meditation practice, lessons, and conversations about awareness.
records.platforms: iOS, Android, Web
records.pricing: Paid membership after a trial; scholarships can provide access for people unable to afford membership.
records.tradeoff: Scholarship access requires a request; it is not an unconditional free tier. The curriculum emphasizes contemplative practice.

notionSupplements.pricing: Free core app with optional paid Sync and Publish services.
notionSupplements.tradeoff: Vendor Sync and Publish are paid add-ons, rather than included free cloud services.

notionSupplements.platforms: Windows, Linux, Android are listed by the official download search result; other platforms need page review.
notionSupplements.pricing: Free tier plus paid memberships are indicated by the official pricing search result; full limits need page review.
notionSupplements.tradeoff: Download and pricing pages could not be extracted during research; platform coverage and membership limits remain provisional.

notionSupplements.platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android; Browser
notionSupplements.pricing: Free Personal Cloud plan and per-member Pro subscription; self-hosted terms need separate review.
notionSupplements.tradeoff: Personal Cloud has storage and upload limits; Pro is billed per workspace member.

notionSupplements.pricing: Free Cloud plan with paid plans; commercial authorization is required for modifying or redistributing the EE backend.
notionSupplements.tradeoff: Editor licensing and self-hosted backend licensing differ; MIT editor licensing does not establish an unrestricted MIT backend.

notionSupplements.pricing: Free core app with optional paid Joplin Cloud plans.
notionSupplements.tradeoff: Cloud storage and collaboration allowances depend on the selected paid Cloud plan.

notionSupplements.platforms: Desktop, Web, and mobile offerings; exact OS and file-graph versus DB-graph version must be checked.
notionSupplements.tradeoff: The DB version and its mobile alpha differ from file-graph workflows; Android DB support is described as upcoming.
